note: What a server sends to carry data to a module of the client's own. A client handles it even before it is ready to play. Kind 1 loads the module, its data's first four bytes kept; kind 2 hands the data to the module; kind 4 has the module turn the data into a whole message the client then handles as if it had arrived; any other kind is handled as such a message at once. A server need send none.

fields.name: length
fields.note: How many bytes of data follow; at most 1024.

fields.name: data
fields.note: Data for a module of the client's own, which the message only carries.
